morning.title: Tokens: why AI 'reads' in chunks
morning.hook: AI doesn't read letters. It reads tokens.
morning.script:
HOOK: AI doesn't read letters. It reads tokens.
CONTEXT: That's why long prompts cost more and hit limits.
CORE: Text is split into tokens — pieces of words. Models predict the next token. Rough rule of thumb: English ≈ a few characters per token, but it varies by language and model.
MEANING: Shorter clear prompts often work better than long vague ones.
CTA: ASR LABS — practical AI, no fluff.

Tokens = the units AI thinks in.
